children: Falcon Finance plans to unlock about 203.06 million FF in December 2026. The release covers tokens allocated to the ecosystem, the foundation, investors and the team.
The amount set to become available for sale is equal to 5.73% of FF's circulating supply. That adds a potential source of selling pressure if holders of the newly unlocked tokens choose to sell.

title: Falcon Finance: 203.06 Million FF Unlocks - Dec 2026
